strategy_roster.name: ADX Trend
strategy_roster.notes: ADX trend filter (AdxPeriod=14, exit threshold 20) with 50-bar MA trend. Corpus stops are ATR-multiple based, not representable as fixed pct; left null.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Histogram Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: MACD (12,26,9) zero-line crossover of the histogram, documented StopLoss=2%.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: Fade closes beyond lower Bollinger band (20,2), exit on return to mid band. Corpus stop is ATR-based; left null.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Band Width Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2) > sma(bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2), 20) and close > bb_mid(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Band width expanding above its 20-bar average with price above the mid-band; exit when band width contracts. Corpus stop is ATR-based; left null.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Surge
strategy_roster.notes: VolumeSurgeMultiplier=2 relative to 20-bar average; exit when volume drops below average. Corpus lists a stop but no pct; used 2.0 proxy.

strategy_roster.name: ZScore Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: Long when 20-bar close z-score below -2, exit when z-score crosses 0. Documented StopLossPercent=2.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Overbought/Oversold
strategy_roster.notes: Long on RSI(14) oversold (<30), exit at neutral 50. Documented StopLossPercent=2.

strategy_roster.name: 52-Week High
strategy_roster.notes: Prior-252-bar high breakout (prior 52 weeks, daily). Exit on 10% pullback from breakout high; corpus 'new low' exit omitted conservatively. Volatility sizing not representable.

strategy_roster.entry_long: close >= low + 0.8 * (high - low) and open <= low + 0.2 * (high - low)
strategy_roster.exit_long: open >= low + 0.8 * (high - low) and close <= low + 0.2 * (high - low)
strategy_roster.notes: Close in top 20% with open in bottom 20% of the bar range; exit on opposite 80-20 signal. Corpus: no stops.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Failure Swing
strategy_roster.notes: RSI crosses back above 30 (long failure swing); exit when RSI fades below neutral 50. Corpus exit 'crosses the opposite level' ambiguous; 50 used conservatively. Documented StopLoss=2%.
